entries.name: 3/4 Sit-Up
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the trunk curls to 45 degrees (three-quarters of the full fold) with the hands at the temples. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a three-quarter sit-up curling to 45

frames.caption: Lie back with the hands lightly at the temples and the pelvis set.
Brace before moving, then curl the trunk up.
Complete the trunk action through a range you can own.
Pause with the trunk braced and the pelvis quiet.
Own the return without momentum.
Lower the trunk back down one segment at a time.

entries.name: Cable Seated Crunch
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the hands hold a cable handle at the chest on a cable to the drawn pulley, and the torso rides a drawn bench pad (the template names bench and cable machine). Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a seated cable crunch on a bench.....

frames.caption: Sit on the bench holding the cable handle at the chest.
Curl the trunk forward against the cable with the pelvis set.
Finish the curl through a range you can own.
Pause with the abdominals shortened.
Return slowly against the cable tension.
Set the trunk tall before the next rep.

entries.name: Jackknife Sit-Up
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the legs lift (the knees and feet rise together, the bones holding) while the hands reach toward the feet - the folding tell an athlete sees at a glance. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a jackknife sit-up folding hands to f

frames.caption: Lie back with the arms reaching overhead and the legs long.
Lift the legs and curl the trunk toward one another.
Reach the hands toward the feet at the top.
Pause with the trunk and the legs folded together.
Open both ends again without momentum.
Return long and set the pelvis for the next rep.

entries.name: Janda Sit-Up
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the arms crossed over the chest (the position the instruction gives it) with the knees bent ninety degrees and the feet flat. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Six drawn positions of a Janda sit-up with the arms crossed.

frames.caption: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the arms crossed over the chest.
Squeeze the glutes and hamstrings first, then start the curl.
Curl the trunk up over a slow three to six second count.
Hold that tension for the whole rep.
Take the descent as slowly as the climb.
Lower back down under the same tension.
